title: Comfort Club Member Benefits on Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Active on the posting date.** Comfort Club member benefits apply on Repair and Emergency Service Calls only when the customer's Comfort Club agreement is in active status on the date the charge line posts. The status is read from the agreement record of the agreement whose benefit is applied. A pending, past-due, lapsed or cancelled agreement earns none. Benefits are never applied retroactively to lines posted before the agreement became active.

**Repair discount.** Each repair parts line and repair labor line receives the repair discount percentage of the member's tier as a member repair discount. The duct cleaning task instead receives the tier's duct cleaning discount percentage.

**Refrigerant clause, no longer in force.** The former clause under which refrigerant added on an enrolled system was free up to the tier's refrigerant allowance per term, counted across all of the member's calls in the current term, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current refrigerant allowance basis, and the tier's per-term refrigerant pounds remain a figure of the tier.

**Fee rates.** Member diagnostic rates and member premium discounts follow the terms for diagnostic fees and after-hours premiums.

**Guarantee.** A repair done while the agreement is active carries a repair guarantee extended by the tier's repair guarantee extension, in months, under the repair guarantee terms.

**Line and rounding.** Each member discount names the agreement and the line it reduces, and is rounded to the cent half up.

All of these percentages, pounds and months are figures of the member's Comfort Club tier.

## Status check

| Agreement status on the posting date | Member repair discount on the line |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Pending | No |
| Past due | No |
| Lapsed | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical tier figure)

A member's tier lists a 15 percent repair discount (illustrative). A blower motor replacement posts a parts line of $342.00 and a labor line of $387.00 while the agreement is active. The member repair discounts are $51.30 on the parts line and $58.05 on the labor line. Each names the agreement and its line. Had the lines posted the week before the agreement became active, neither would receive a discount, then or later.

superseded_clauses: Refrigerant added on an enrolled system is free up to the tier's refrigerant_allowance_lbs_per_term, counted across all of the member's calls in the current term, and posted as a member_refrigerant_allowance discount for the pounds covered at the billed price per pound.
